name: EvChargingSiteOperationsConsole
tagline: Keep every charging port earning – fault tickets, SLA clocks and NEVI-style uptime in one app.
description: A complete EV charging operations app for charge point operators, utilities and site hosts: ports and sites with live status; fault tickets with OCPP fault codes, priorities and safety lock-out; remote troubleshooting with an attempt limit; technician dispatch with capacity and SLA checks; on-site, parts, resolution and test-session verification; planned maintenance; response and restore SLA per priority; per-port uptime with excluded causes; sessions, energy and success rates; work order, uptime and summary outputs for Power Automate.
features: Demo mode with a fictional 40-port charging network
OCPP fault codes with priority, cause and safety lock-out
Dispatch with technician capacity and SLA check
Waiting for parts with ETA vs SLA
Response and restore SLA per priority, at-risk warning
NEVI-style port uptime with excluded causes
Bulk remote command, dispatch, uptime report, export
Work order, uptime, CSV and summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: EvChargingSiteOperationsConsole data-set + EvChargingSiteOperationsConsolePortal field)
